text: Rakhsh Khodro Diesel is a subsidiary of the Daric Investment Development Group; the company says all of its shares were transferred from the previous shareholders to Daric Investment in 2018 (1397).
short: All of Rakhsh Khodro Diesel's shares were transferred to Daric Investment in 2018.

source.name: Rakhsh Khodro Diesel: About us (archived by the Wayback Machine)
source.quote: تمام سهام این شرکت در سال ۱۳۹۷ از سهامداران قبلی به شرکت سرمایه گذاری دریک واگذار شده است
source.note: The live site (rakhshkhodro.com) was unreachable from the research server; the archived capture carries the same About us text. Persian: all shares transferred to Daric Investment in 1397 (2018).
